llm.summary: This is an instruction-only valuation playbook that only transforms structured inputs into a standardized report; it asks for no credentials, installs, or external network calls and is internally consistent with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the content: the SKILL.md defines a valuation playbook (multiples, DCF, scenarios, confidence rubric) and the instructions only operate on pre-fetched, structured financial inputs. There are no unexpected requirements (no cloud creds, no unrelated binaries).
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions stay within the stated scope: validate input bundles, run data-quality gates, select modules (Multiples, DCF, sector adaptations), build scenarios, and emit a report. The skill explicitly states it does not fetch data and references upstream data providers; it does not instruct reading local system files, environment variables, or sending data to external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. This minimizes disk footprint and execution risk; nothing is downloaded or written by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. All required inputs are declared as fields of the input bundle, so requested privileges are proportional to purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable. It does not request persistent presence or attempt to modify other skills or system settings. Autonomous agent invocation is allowed (default) but that is appropriate for a transformation/reporting skill.

dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it only processes structured financial inputs and asks for nothing external. Before installing, confirm that the upstream data sources (vnstock-free-expert, nso/us/vn monitors) you will feed into this skill are trusted and that the input bundle contains no sensitive credentials. If you plan to allow autonomous agent runs, be aware the agent could generate reports without additional confirmation — consider requiring user confirmation for any trading or high-impact decisions and verify assumptions (WACC, terminal growth, scenario weights) in produced reports before acting on them.
